verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a cloud-based design tool like Spline, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out. The self-hosted export and sandboxed iframe are adjacent features, not telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
